title: Plant manager
text:
Job Description

Posting Start Date: 11/17/26

Offer ID: 2814

Unit: HM Clause

**Job Title:** **Plant manager**
================================

Job Location: Modesto, USA

Contract type: Permanent

Job Description:

**Company Introduction**
------------------------

#### ***“WE BUILD TRUST WITH FARMERS AROUND THE WORLD BY SUPPORTING THEM TO SUSTAINABLY IMPROVE THE QUALITY AND FLAVOR OF THEIR PRODUCTION.”***

 

**HM.CLAUSE** is a Business Unit of **Limagrain** , an international agricultural co-operative founded and managed by farmers. **HM.CLAUSE** specializes in the breeding, production, and sale of vegetable seeds. From the world market to the farmer's market, we collaborate with our customers to deliver successful solutions for the agricultural challenges of today and produce the highest quality vegetable seeds for the future. Our global team of experts and state-of-the-art research facilities enable us to work side-by-side with growers to provide the most regionally relevant and reliable vegetable seeds available.

 

*If our mission resonates with your passion, we look forward to your application.*

**Job description**
-------------------

**You will be a great fit if you have experience similar to:**

Manufacturing Leadership
 

* Lead all manufacturing operations to deliver SQCDME objectives.
* Define annual operational priorities, targets and improvement roadmaps.
* Ensure production plans are achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and service.
* Monitor plant performance through KPIs, visual management systems and operational reviews.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives across all manufacturing areas.
* Develop and maintain adequate organizational structures supporting current and future business needs.
* Ensure effective deployment of corporate manufacturing programs and standards.
* Lead crisis management and business continuity activities impacting manufacturing operations.
* Support S&OP execution and capacity planning processes to ensure alignment between demand and manufacturing capability.
* Develop and execute productivity, efficiency and waste reduction programs.

Safety, Quality and Compliance
 

* Ensure all manufacturing activities comply with company standards, local regulations and applicable legal requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture through visible leadership, employee engagement and accountability.
* Ensure completion and continuous improvement of Job Safety Analyses (JSA), risk assessments, safety tours and safety programs.
* Lead investigations related to safety, quality or environmental incidents affecting manufacturing operations.
* Ensure quality systems, procedures, audits and corrective actions are effectively deployed and sustained.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Ensure manufacturing operations comply with all environmental obligations and permit requirements.

People Leadership
 

* Recruit, develop, coach and retain manufacturing talent.
* Conduct performance reviews and succession planning for key positions.
* Lead regular one-on-one meetings with direct reports.
* Foster employee engagement, teamwork, accountability and continuous learning.
* Support implementation of organizational changes and transformation projects.
* Promote company values and leadership principles throughout the organization.

Financial and Asset Management
 

* Prepare, manage and control the manufacturing operating budget.
* Develop and monitor annual OPEX and CAPEX plans.
* Build business cases and investment proposals supporting business growth and operational improvements.
* Ensure efficient utilization of labor, equipment and material resources.
* Drive initiatives focused on productivity, cost optimization and financial performance improvement.
* Monitor departmental spending and ensure compliance with approved budgets.

**Job Description Continued**
-----------------------------

Site Management Responsibilities
 

* Serve as the primary site representative toward regulatory agencies, government authorities and external stakeholders.
* Ensure all site permits, authorizations and regulatory requirements remain compliant and up to date.
* Coordinate site-wide activities between Manufacturing, Laboratory, Administrative functions and Facilities.
* Chair or coordinate the site leadership governance process.
* Ensure proper site infrastructure, facility maintenance and utilities management in partnership with Facilities.
* Lead site emergency preparedness and crisis management processes.
* Ensure security programs and site access controls are maintained and effective.
* Coordinate site safety matters affecting common areas and shared services.
* Promote collaboration and alignment among all site functions to ensure overall site performance and compliance.
* Support sustainability and environmental improvement initiatives across the site.

Communication and Leadership
 

* Lead plant leadership meetings and performance reviews.
* Ensure effective communication of business objectives, priorities and results.
* Maintain strong relationships with corporate functions including Supply Chain, Quality, HR, Finance, EHS, Engineering and Commercial teams.
* Participate actively in regional and global operations forums.
* Provide timely reporting to senior leadership regarding operational performance, risks and opportunities.

**To be considered, you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Management, Manufacturing, Operations Management or related field.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of manufacturing or industrial operations experience.
* Minimum 5 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and operational budgets.
* Experience with regulatory compliance, environmental management and site governance preferred

**Your benefits and working environment**
-----------------------------------------

**The rewards of working here:** You join an expert team of innovators and creators that collaborate with farmers around the world to sustainably enhance the taste and quality of healthy food. Our goal is to form teams that inspire and learn from each other as they work to elevate our products from seed to table. We recognize our employees as our most valued resource and work to create an atmosphere that is supportive, healthy, and progressive. We promote an environment of wellness and well-being and hybrid schedules when it is appropriate for the position. It is an important and expanding piece of our local and global mission for Diversity & Inclusion programs and support groups in the corporate world.

 

HM.CLAUSE offers a strong compensation and benefits package to its employees:

* Competitive salary
* + This position’s range is **$116,000 - $146,000**

Our total compensation and pay ranges reflect our market pay structures. As such, individual salaries or hourly rates are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: local geographical market conditions, internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as job related skills, education, and experience.

* Comprehensive Benefits Choices
* + Medical, Dental, Vision
* Work/Life Balance
* + 12 Paid Holidays per year
 + +1 Floating Holiday per year
 + Paid shutdown holidays
 + Progressive time off starting at 80-vacation hours
* Company Covered Benefits
* + Company paid Life Insurance, Long and Short-Term Disability
* Wellness Benefits
* + Family EAP, Telehealth and Mental Wellness Services
* Internal Career Progression
* + Learning Environment
 + Promotions from within
 + Paid Annual Training
 + Tuition Reimbursement
* Welcoming Environment
* + Business casual attire; open door policy
* Financial Wellness
* + 401(k) dollar for dollar Employer matching
 + Supplemental Employer Contribution Plan
 + Traditional and Roth (401k) plans options
 + Company Profit sharing in December
* Family Benefits
* + Maternity and Paternity paid time off
 + Low family medical deductibles
 + Family Planning Resources

We are a company with a supportive culture and leadership. We encourage you to be part of our journey to enhance the world’s food supply and support the farmers that grow them.

 

To view all U.S. based privacy rights and how to exercise them, click here: Privacy policy - HM Clause .

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

**The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers to handle and feel. The employee is regularly required to use office equipment and computers. The employee is frequently required to stand; walk and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

 

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

**The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**

 

While performing the duties of this job the employee may be driving cars, trucks, forklifts, or other equipment. This position will be exposed to warehouse and outdoor weather conditions. The employee may need to walk on uneven ground, work near equipment or machinery, work in a dusty environment, and may be exposed to vibration or constant movement. The noise level that is typical of this work environment is loud.
